# Third-party libraries

Copied into the project so the app never loads code from another website at runtime.

| File | Library | Version | Licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| supabase.js | @supabase/supabase-js (dist/umd/supabase.js) | 2.118.0 | MIT |
| qrcode.js | qrcode-generator | 1.4.4 | MIT |

To update, download the new version from npm, replace the file, and update this table.
